note: REQ-0184. The 4 packs previously inlined as encounterDef.enemyPack.enemyIds in dungeon.json, ported to first-class monster_pack/1 defs with an EXPLICIT layout. A member's `at` is its A1 TOP-LEFT anchor on the enemy plane; the cells it occupies are derived from the enemy def's footprint (shared/content_validate.cjs cellsFor) and are never stored. The placeable area is B2:Y17 (24x16) inside the 26x18 field -- see the port note below.
port_note: These layouts are the PORT of the pre-REQ-0184 placement, not a rebalance. compileEnemyPack() used to fill from the box origin left-to-right, and encounter.cjs handed it the WHOLE A1:Z18 plane -- so every pack stood on the margin (frost_gnoll at A1, etc). The user ruled 2026-07-15 that 24x16/B2:Y17 is canon and the margin-riding was a bug. The fix is a pure origin shift A1 -> B2: the relative arrangement within each pack is byte-for-byte what it was. Re-composing these packs as game design (anchor forward, support behind, spread vs AoE) is a separate REQ with its own ratification -- doing it here would make the golden diff unreadable.

entries.name: Frost Scouts
entries.note: was enc_pack_1 enemyIds [frost_gnoll, ice_archer]; ported A1,B1 -> B2,C2

entries.name: Rime Choir
entries.note: was enc_pack_2 enemyIds [rime_shaman, glacier_wisp, glacier_wisp]; ported A1,B1,C1 -> B2,C2,D2. The two glacier_wisp members are distinct instances (glacier_wisp#1, glacier_wisp#2) -- member ORDER names the instance, so it is stable, not cosmetic.

entries.name: Bear and Stalker
entries.note: was enc_pack_3 enemyIds [frostback_bear, niflheim_stalker]; ported A1,C1 -> B2,D2. frostback_bear footprint [2,2] occupies B2:C3, which is why the stalker anchors at D2 and not C2 -- the cursor skipped by footprint width and the port preserves that exactly.

entries.name: Hrimgrimnir

ja.name: フリームグリームニル

entries.note: was enc_boss enemyIds [hrimgrimnir]; ported A1 -> B2. footprint [3,3] occupies B2:D4.

entries.name: Grave Shamble
entries.note: Weakness appliers (festering grasp, mummy's curse) soften the squad while a lifesteal ghost sustains the shambling front.

entries.name: Grave Legion
entries.note: The full Weakness engine: zombie/necromancer APPLY Weakness, skeleton & wight CONVERT it x1.5 (bone_cleaver/grave_blade), while life_drain + dark_mending SUSTAIN the line.

entries.name: Bone Court
entries.note: Boss court: the bone dragon's roar and the necromancer stack Weakness while the lich blasts/stuns and dark_mending keeps the throne standing.

entries.name: Wild Hunt
entries.note: Lifesteal tempo: fast melee (alpha_werewolf rending/feral, dire_wolf, boar tusk) sustains through damage via feral_bite while the giant bat's blood_drain feeds from the flank.

entries.name: Venom Nest
entries.note: Poison engine: giant_spider (venom_bite) and giant_snake (venom_spit) stack Poison, then giant_scorpion (stinger) and basilisk (toxic_maw) cash it in via bonus_vs_status x1.5.

entries.name: Demon Gate
entries.note: Burn engine: the imps (fire_dart) and demon_lord (dominion_of_flame) set the squad alight, then gargoyle (molten_talons) converts Burn x1.5 while dullahan anchors the gate.

entries.name: Deep Tide
entries.note: Chill engine at sea: sahuagin (cold_current), giant_crab (barnacle_grip) and the kraken boss (abyssal_grip) freeze the squad, then sea_serpent (tidal_fang) cashes Chill in via bonus_vs_status x1.5 while the kraken crushes with multi_strike.

entries.name: Petrifying Court
entries.note: Stun engine: medusa (petrifying_glare) and cockatrice (petri_peck) petrify the squad, then stone_golem (seismic_fist) converts Stun via bonus_vs_status x1.5 while lamia sustains with serpents_kiss lifesteal and softens with beguiling_song Weakness.

entries.name: Greenskin Warband
entries.note: Swarm tempo + sustain + Weakness convert: fast goblin/kobold spears and the ogre anchor pressure the line, goblin/goblin_shaman apply Weakness (goblin_jeer, hex_bolt) which orc_warrior (brutal_cleave) cashes in via bonus_vs_status x1.5, while goblin_shaman heals the lowest ally with crude_mending (heal_ally).

entries.name: Titan Ridge
entries.note: Big hits + a Chill engine: the behemoth boss (cataclysm_horns multi_strike, earthshatter Stun) and cyclops (log_swing) land heavy blows, frost_giant applies Chill (winters_call) then converts it (glacial_axe) via bonus_vs_status x1.5, and troll sustains with trollish_vigor lifesteal.
